svg.title: 一個被標出的區域怎麼被處置
svg.desc: Flowchart: the re-verifier classifies a flagged region; a confident false call is dismissed and a confident defect confirmed without a language model; anything else gathers production context and criteria, the LLM writes a rationale, and the region is decided on the classifier's confidence or handed to an operator through a durable interrupt.
